verdict.rationale: The public Business & Liens portal offers a search by business name or file number, plus a UCC/tax lien search by debtor name or file number, so a founder can look up their entity or lien records without logging in. However, nothing documents a public status tracker for a pending filing or application. The Transaction History that lets users view filings sits behind an Online Account login and covers only completed filings for up to 90 days. Missing for 10: explicit public status display for pending or in-process filings/applications, documentation of which status fields the public search shows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
